top_violation_types.title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - Age Requirement (26 TAC §746.1107(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver is still missing education requirements.

top_violation_types.title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An incident report was not on record or provided for review  during the investigation.

top_violation_types.title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A report was not made to Child Care Regulation for an incident that potentially posed a risk to children.

top_violation_types.title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not notify parent in a timely manner of a situation involving their child.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers did not know how many children they were responsible for.

top_violation_types.title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption with HS Diploma/GED- Not in Charge of Group (26 TAC §746.1109(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information gathered through interviews during this investigation from staff, a 17-year-old staff member was left alone supervising school age children on separate occasions.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.
